about: L005 records dexchlorpheniramine as the first treatment for this urticaria, and the earlier cetirizine at L004 was for hay fever.
Possible finding: L010 records dexchlorpheniramine for hives, but the reason for the cetirizine at L009 is unknown.
Phenergan (promethazine hydrochloride, an older antihistamine) is supplied three times, but a condition line records motion sickness as the reason, so it is not for allergy or itch and must not flag.
